name: Theo Priestley
bio:
I am a AAA and live-service experienced narrative designer, game writer, world builder, and lore wrangler – in essence, a Story Architect.

I am also a screenwriter and a published author of non-fiction and speculative fiction.

I've helped produce independent feature and short films, designed and written for tabletop and play-by-mail roleplaying games.

Specialties include narrative design, game writing, worldbuilding, screenwriting, tabletop RPG design, creative consulting, transmedia development, lore writing, branching dialogue, voice-over scripting and direction, story architecture, and storytelling.
short_bio: AAA and live-service narrative designer, game writer and Story Architect — screenwriter and published author; film and tabletop RPG experience.
